accounting.rationale: Defines the ATOMIC_DEFINE intrinsic procedure's purpose.
Classifies the intrinsic as an atomic subroutine.
Arguments paragraph mixes argument restrictions, successful effects, error undefinedness, STAT handling, and status/error-termination delegation; these are split into fine units.
16.5 p4 requires STAT to be zero when no error condition occurs; observation still requires an out-of-scope coarray ATOM.
16.5 p5 separately requires STAT_FAILED_IMAGE when ATOM is on a failed image; failed-image/coarray observations are out of scope.
16.5 p5 grants processor latitude for the exact positive STAT value for non-failed-image atomic errors, constrained only to be positive and distinct from STAT_FAILED_IMAGE.
16.5 p6 requires error termination when an atomic error occurs and STAT is absent; observing the atomic error trigger is out of scope.
Example paragraph is illustrative only; it is not the basis for a normative requirement or fixture oracle.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9.29-16.9.38, the atomic subroutines (batch183). Every unit verified by an independent reviewer across three rounds; every runtime facet is out of scope because the atomic argument must be a coarray, STAT semantics are split per 16.5, and no catalogue asserts a review state. Source accounting only.
